description: One import, as its page on the Import tab shows it: the import itself; 'plan' — what would be carried (issues, comments, worklogs, attachments, versions), 'blockers' that stop it, the units it would spend ('units.over' true means start_import needs acceptUnits), the Jira statuses and where they could go, 'people' — every Jira account with its accountId, name, address where Jira shows it, how much it did and the member it matches — and what is not carried; 'choices' made at the start; 'report' once done; 'members' — the company's people by username, for matching; 'links' — who the company already said each Jira account is. The company's administrator only.
name: get_import
title: Get import
